intro: Our aesthetic medicine division is led by Dra. Rosibel Núñez Rojo, Médico Cirujano from the Universidad Autónoma de Guadalajara (Cédula Profesional 7408277). Every treatment starts with an in-person evaluation, so you get an honest recommendation — or a recommendation not to treat.
We offer four categories of treatment. Prices and the specific technique are confirmed after your evaluation.

list: Lip fillers — volume and definition for the lips.
Facial botulinum toxin treatments — for expression lines of the face.
Facial rejuvenation — treatments chosen for your skin after evaluation.
Skin brightening treatments — for luminosity and uneven skin tone; technique confirmed at your evaluation.
Evaluation first. Dra. Rosibel reviews your goals, your health history and any medicines you take.
Clear information. You receive the plan, expected results, possible risks, recovery and the total price before deciding.
Treatment and aftercare. You get written aftercare instructions and a way to reach the team if you have questions.

p: Results vary from person to person and are not guaranteed. Some treatments are not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding, with certain medical conditions or right before sun exposure and travel — that is why the evaluation matters. We do not publish before-and-after photos without patient authorization.
Message us on WhatsApp at +52 624 226 1023 with the treatment you are interested in and the dates you are in Cabo, and we will propose a time for your evaluation.

faq.q: Do you offer lip fillers in Cabo San Lucas?
faq.a: Yes, after an in-person evaluation with Dra. Rosibel Núñez Rojo. The technique and price are confirmed at the evaluation.
Our aesthetic medicine division is led by Dra. Rosibel Núñez Rojo, Médico Cirujano (UAG), Cédula Profesional 7408277.

faq.q: How much do aesthetic treatments cost?
faq.a: Prices depend on the treatment and are confirmed after your evaluation, before you decide.

faq.q: Can I get treated on vacation?
faq.a: Often yes, but timing matters: the doctor will tell you whether sun, swimming or flights soon after the treatment are a problem.
